Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; __radially reinforcing the device against brain tissue;__ and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __and wherein the radially reinforcing step comprises expanding a stent within the device__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel to achieve a therapeutic effect__.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening, __wherein the radially reinforcing step maintains the working channel during the medical procedure__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain, __wherein the radially reinforcing step prevents collapse of the working channel__.

Claim 6 (Original): The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __using a stent positioned within the device__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __and wherein the stent maintains structural integrity of the working channel__.

Claim 9 (Original): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers, __wherein the stent prevents tissue ingrowth into the working channel__.

Claim 11 (Original): The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue.

Claim 12 (Original): The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.

Claim 13 (Original): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

Claim 14 (Original): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

Claim 15 (Original): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

Claim 16 (Original): The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers.

Claim 17 (Original): The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
